g.title: instruction
g.text: “pick up the black bowl next to …”

g.title: target phrase · Rule: the object of the first manipulation verb; SmolVLM2 answers from the first frame; the rule wins on disagreement.
SAM 3 video tracking
g.text: target and end-effector masks, boxes, scores

g.title: feature cache (Parquet, keyed by episode and frame)
g.text: feature cache (Parquet, keyed by episode and frame)
inputs: K = 4 object descriptors on every frame, from frame t only
targets: every 4th frame, may use the whole episode, each with a confidence
CoT traces written from the labels: phase · object · motion
the manifest pins model hashes, prompts, thresholds, strides and camera
<cot> phase: approach | object: black bowl | motion: down </cot>
No human labels. Simulator ground truth only validates the
pseudo-labels and drives the oracle ablation.

g.title: SurgicalVLA (Fig. 1), one forward pass per sample · Frozen VLM; the action expert, object projector, latent queries and heads are trained.
g.text: SurgicalVLA (Fig. 1), one forward pass per sample
inputs: cameras, ℓ, st, cached object descriptors, CoT trace (curriculum), noisy chunk x_τ

g.title: vision encoder · With the vision encoder frozen the target encoder is the encoder itself; an EMA copy (decay 0.99) exists only when it trains.

g.text: ℒSFT = ℒFM + Σk wk ℒaux,k + 0.1 ℒCoT
Auxiliary losses read the action expert (aux_source = expert),
so they shape features the policy acts on while the VLM is frozen.

g.title: training.mode
g.text: joint: + λt ℒFM on demo batches, λ 1 → 0.1 (cosine)
interleaved: FM steps between RL updates
Evaluation always uses the deterministic ODE (10 Euler steps)
and the model saved after the fixed final iteration.

svg.text: Inputs to the policy are past-only; targets may use the whole episode and enter only the losses. Thick arrows: the main path; dashed: targets.
